works.title: Public Compass
works.statement: Seen from above, society appears divided into patches of faith, background and religion. The golden patches run through all of them, regardless of gender, colour or faith. Gold is the true constant of human history.

image.alt: Public Compass — red and green abstract painting with gold patches

works.originalStatement: Social differences are evident when seen from top. Our society is divided in different patches of faith, background or religion. Only thing common between all of us-the golden patches irrespective of gender, color, faith. Gold is the true constant of human history

works.title: Tumult
works.statement: Life keeps moving, towards chaos and away from it. Where are you heading? What are you moving towards, and what are you leaving behind? The answer depends on where you stand.

image.alt: Tumult — yellow, teal and black abstract painting

works.originalStatement:
Depends on the perspective of the viewer,

Life keeps moving till it lasts, the movement towards chaos and from chaos. See where are you heading towards it/them/him/her or away from it/them/him/her.

works.title: Celestial
works.statement: I question our endless effort to make a dent in the universe. Among billions of stars and planets, we live on one tiny planet. Is your life worth as much as you think it is?

image.alt: Celestial — blue abstract painting with dark lines and yellow accents

works.originalStatement: Questioning the endless efforts of Humans to make a dent in the universe. A universe with billions and trillions of stars & planets, where we just exist on one tiny planet. Is your life worth as much as you think it is?

works.title: Continual
works.statement: A small marble in the bigger picture of life. We were destined to meet: if not today, then maybe tomorrow; if not here, then somewhere near; if not like this, then another way. If we did not have a happy ending here, we will have one there.

image.alt: Continual — overlapping bands of green, blue, red and yellow

works.originalStatement:
A small marble in a bigger picture of life. We were destined to meet-
if not today, then may be tomorrow,
If not here, then maybe somewhere near,
If not like, this then maybe like that,
If we didn't have a happy ending here, then we will have one there.

works.title: Live-life
works.statement: Happiness, joy and fulfilment are always around us. It is a matter of noticing them.

image.alt: Live-life — the complete three-panel green, blue and yellow composition

works.originalStatement:
Depends on the perspective of the viewer,

Happiness/Joy/Fulfillment is always around us, it's always about acknowledgment.
